meta.rationale: A brass clockwork machine: gears mesh and turn behind glass, and each app is an engraved plaque on a lever.
meta.theme-about: steampunk clockwork: a full-screen canvas of interlocking brass and copper gears of many sizes turning at matched speeds (teeth, spokes, rivets) over a dark walnut panel, a big pressure gauge whose needle moves, steam pipes along the edges; the time on a round brass clock face with roman-ish numerals drawn in the canvas; the apps as engraved brass plaques screwed onto the panel at the right, in a column, each a button; serif engraved type, windows with brass frames and riveted title bars. Victorian, mechanical, ornate. (#machine, #plaques)

desktop.canvas: local function gear(cx, cy, r, teeth, ang, col, dark) local pts = {} for i = 0, teeth * 4 - 1 do local a = ang + i / (teeth * 4) * 6.283 local rr = (i % 4 == 1 or i % 4 == 2) and r or r * 0.86 pts[#pts + 1] = cx + math.cos(a) * rr pts[#pts + 1] = cy + math.sin(a) * rr end g.poly(pts, col) g.circle(cx, cy, r * 0.72, dark) g.circle(cx, cy, r * 0.62, col) for k = 0, 4 do local a = ang + k / 5 * 6.283 g.line(cx, cy, cx + math.cos(a) * r * 0.62, cy + math.sin(a) * r * 0.62, dark, r * 0.12) end g.circle(cx, cy, r * 0.2, dark) g.circle(cx, cy, r * 0.1, "#f6d690") end function draw(w, h, t) g.gradient(0, 0, w, h, "#3a2418", "#120a06") for i = 0, 30 do g.line(0, i * h / 30, w, i * h / 30 + 10, "rgba(0,0,0,0.12)", 3) end local s = t * 0.4 gear(w * 0.28, h * 0.42, 170, 24, s, "#b8862e", "#5a3a14") gear(w * 0.28 + 170 + 92, h * 0.42 - 30, 100, 14, -s * 24 / 14 + 0.12, "#c87a40", "#5a2a10") gear(w * 0.28 - 60, h * 0.42 + 230, 80, 11, -s * 24 / 11 + 0.2, "#d4a24c", "#5a3a14") gear(w * 0.28 + 170 + 92 + 130, h * 0.42 + 110, 64, 9, s * 24 / 9 * 14 / 24, "#a8782c", "#4a2a0a") gear(w * 0.1, h * 0.16, 60, 9, s * 2, "#c87a40", "#5a2a10") local gx, gy, gr = w * 0.55, h * 0.78, 90 g.circle(gx, gy, gr + 10, "#6a4a1a") g.circle(gx, gy, gr, "#f1e4c8") for i = 0, 10 do local a = 2.4 + i / 10 * 4.5 g.line(gx + math.cos(a) * gr * 0.8, gy + math.sin(a) * gr * 0.8, gx + math.cos(a) * gr * 0.95, gy + math.sin(a) * gr * 0.95, "#2a1a10", 2) end local na = 2.4 + (0.55 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 0.7)) * 4.5 g.line(gx, gy, gx + math.cos(na) * gr * 0.85, gy + math.sin(na) * gr * 0.85, "#b0302e", 3) g.circle(gx, gy, 8, "#2a1a10") g.text(gx - 30, gy + 30, "PSI", "#2a1a10", 16, "PlayfairDisplay") local cx, cy, cr = w * 0.28, h * 0.42, 108 local hh = g.clock() local hrA = (hh % 12) / 12 * 6.283 - 1.5708 local mnA = (hh % 1) * 6.283 - 1.5708 g.circle(cx, cy, cr, "#f1e4c8") g.arc(cx, cy, cr, 0, 6.29, "#6a4a1a", 6) local N = {"XII", "III", "VI", "IX"} for i = 0, 3 do local a = i / 4 * 6.283 - 1.5708 g.text(cx + math.cos(a) * cr * 0.74 - 14, cy + math.sin(a) * cr * 0.74 - 12, N[i + 1], "#2a1a10", 20, "PlayfairDisplay") end g.line(cx, cy, cx + math.cos(hrA) * cr * 0.45, cy + math.sin(hrA) * cr * 0.45, "#2a1a10", 6) g.line(cx, cy, cx + math.cos(mnA) * cr * 0.7, cy + math.sin(mnA) * cr * 0.7, "#2a1a10", 3) g.circle(cx, cy, 6, "#b0302e") g.rect(0, h -
